hints.title: Exam Extremes Identification
hints.text: A student is loud in an exam if their score is the maximum or minimum for that exam.

hints.title: Window Ranking across Exams
hints.text: Compute rank() over (partition by exam_id order by score asc) and desc to flag rank 1 students.

hints.title: Exclusion of Loud Students
hints.text: Select distinct students who took at least one exam and whose student_id is not in the set of loud students.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH ExamRanks AS (
    SELECT exam_id, student_id,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY exam_id ORDER BY score ASC) AS rk_low,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY exam_id ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk_high
    FROM Exam
),
LoudStudents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT student_id
    FROM ExamRanks
    WHERE rk_low = 1 OR rk_high = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.student_name
FROM Student s
JOIN Exam e ON s.student_id = e.student_id
WHERE s.student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM LoudStudents)
ORDER BY s.student_id;
```

complexity.notes: Window ranking groups scores per exam in O(E log E) time followed by set exclusion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries per student and exam cause repeated max and min evaluations across all exams.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Computing ascending and descending ranks simultaneously identifies both extremes in a single CTE pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Window ranking partitioned by exam excluding loud performers from active exam participants.
